review_notes: Issue #5099 reports pyOpenSSL deprecation failures from X509.get_subject, and merged PR #5103 replaces the lookup with cryptography's X.509 API while removing a related password-callback warning.

Retain the pyopenssl production file as file-level ground truth because the pre-fix map contains three conditional WrappedSocket.getpeercert definitions; lock and changelog files are excluded, and unmerged PR #5121 is not a second fix case.
Issue #11228 reproduces docparams crashing when an inferred raise target is a function or module instead of an exception class, and merged PR #11262 guards the ancestry lookup.
Retain possible_exc_types; tests and changelog are excluded.
Issue #11231 reports a TypedDict instance being checked with class naming rules, and merged PR #11232 excludes the instance path without changing functional TypedDict or EnumMeta handling.
Retain NameChecker._should_check_class_regex; tests and changelog are excluded, and regression-source PR #10673 is not another fix case.
Issue #66639 reports read_csv with sep=None no longer falling back to the Python engine, and merged PR #66790 restores fallback while rejecting explicitly incompatible engines.
Retain TextFileReader._clean_options; docs, whatsnew, and tests are excluded, and Issues #66641, #66644, and #66723 are not counted separately.
Issue #27631 reports subprocess shell-injection checks missing keyword arguments, and merged PR #27687 adds keyword-aware argument lookup in the existing Rust rule.
Retain the Rust production file as file-only ground truth; mdtest and other regression tests are excluded.
Issue #713 reports AES-CTR construction failing because PyCrypto receives an IV it does not accept, and merged PR #889 omits the IV for CTR mode.
Retain Transport._get_cipher; tests and changelog are excluded, and unmerged duplicate PR #714 is not counted.
Issue #358 reports wrapped Markup string methods being typed as returning str, and merged PR #376 gives the wrapper a ParamSpec-preserving decorator type and explicit method bindings.
Retain _simple_escaping_wrapper; changelog is excluded and related Issue #364 must not become a duplicate case.
Issue #417 reproduces comments leaving spurious whitespace in Markup.striptags, and merged PR #418 restores stripping comments and tags before collapsing spaces.
Retain Markup.striptags; tests and changelog are excluded. Existing MarkupSafe cases in the same file cover different defects.
Issue #966 reports backend logs disappearing with temporary build directories, and merged PR #1087 emits a failure hint for preserving or locating the working directories.
Retain _handle_build_error; documentation, tests, and changelog are excluded. The required env and extraction flags already exist at the recorded pre-fix SHA.
Issue #98 asks for actionable RemoteProtocolError messages, and merged PR #99 adds specific invalid header, request, status, and chunk details to reader validation.
Retain _decode_header_lines as the representative pre-fix symbol while file ground truth covers the other reader hunks; existing h11 cases target different protocol defects.
